title: Craftable Elytra by Bester play
description: Adds a recipe for the elytra!
body:
Adds a recipe for the elytra!

For craft you need 4x phantom membrana, 2x strings, 1 nether star.

![Craft of the Elytra](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/77b98a7ef7049b79b21b063a49b10e7d03c6290e.png)

Recomended to use mod [Global Packs](https://modrinth.com/project/NRLPy2mk)
